commit.message:
feat: deliver cratylus's workflow context read-only to every project (0207)

The cratylus build projects the journal's workflow context (deliverContext) into
dist/delivered/cratylus/workflow.json; install and deploy place it read-only in
the owned root as handed in. concepts overview/state/design show it as
cratylus:workflow, marked delivered and read-only, unless the project's journal
holds its identity; history/decisions give no versions or decisions; appends
naming it are refused.
